notes: tested_ref is the ref this repo VALIDATED for install.
upstream_head is a LIVE fact and is deliberately not stored here; run `z0 registry doctor` to discover it.
architecture_status is semantic and is independent of tested_ref.
Delegated sources record the relationship and cache policy only. The facts live at the authority.

z0.name: z0
z0.summary: The network almanac: reconciled registry truth, install profiles, generated architecture and the onboarding entry point. Stores Zer0 relationships and policy; fetches upstream facts from the authority that already owns them.

z0archy.name: z0archy
z0archy.summary: Visualisation surface for the generated typed relationship graph.

aodl.name: AODL
aodl.summary: Typed intent IR, compiled plan and observed state with fail-closed validation. Also owns the harness catalog and the Mesh Registry, which z0 CONSUMES rather than duplicating.

z0intelligence.name: z0intelligence
z0intelligence.summary: The cognition plane: semantic model selection and escalation, context resolution, bounded DecisionBackend contracts, the local SLM portfolio, cognition receipts, and ACTIVATION of qualified policies into shadow/canary/active. JEV/NanoJev/OpenJev are implementations behind these contracts, not peers of them.

tokenomics.name: Tokenomics
tokenomics.summary: Vendor-neutral measurement contracts: multi-harness traces, verified outcomes, context economics, experiment identity, quota reconciliation and OTel transport. Owns Zer0-specific semantics; OpenTelemetry remains only the transport.

kerdoios.name: Kerdoios
kerdoios.summary: Resource placement: inventory, hard constraints, dimensional quota/capacity (RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD), cost/capability/privacy dimensions, Pareto selection, reservations and expiry-aware allocation. It is NOT an LLM gateway and does NOT execute providers. Currently shipped as a Hermes plugin; the logical capability is harness-neutral.

evolution-lab.name: Evolution Lab
evolution-lab.summary: Experiment execution: frozen grouped comparisons, training/search, and the QUALIFICATION decision — whether a candidate clears the frozen gates, producing promotion evidence. It neither publishes studies nor activates anything.

z0evals.name: z0evals
z0evals.summary: Frozen reproducible studies and publication: immutable, citable, re-runnable evidence including slm-router-v0. It neither trains nor activates.

frontier-kb.name: Frontier KB
frontier-kb.summary: Cross-harness public research evidence. Research authority, not architecture truth.

dash.name: Dash
dash.summary: Multi-harness phone control surface. A surface, not an executor.

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.summary: Ephemeral intent surface mounted by Dash. Consumes AODL as data; does not own it.

flow.name: Flow
flow.summary: Predicted OS/context state feeding z0intelligence and context compilation. Harness-neutral; the OMP coupling is incidental and must not become architectural.

hermes-keel.name: Hermes Keel
hermes-keel.summary: Performance-based execution kernel for Hermes Agent.

hermes-mesh-keel.name: Hermes Mesh Keel
hermes-mesh-keel.summary: Signed transport and authorization infrastructure. PRE-ACTIVATION: this must not be described as production-active anywhere.

hermes-jev-skills.name: Hermes Jev Skills
hermes-jev-skills.summary: Jev-powered routing, memory, compaction and skill selection for Hermes.

kvnloo-skills.name: kvnloo skills
kvnloo-skills.summary: Personal Hermes skills (Hyprland UI testing and follow-ons).

rlm.name: RLM
rlm.summary: The addressable evidence/context plane: evidence handles, cognitive-state compilation and context virtualization. It has NO repo of its own — it lives as branches on the OMP fork, which currently carries 102 local branches across six checkouts. One lineage must be designated canonical before anything about "the RLM design" is claimed.

sol-pi-omp.name: SoL-Pi for OMP
sol-pi-omp.summary: OMP-loadable implementation of the SoL-Pi mechanism family — Action Fusion and ObservationPack — without patching the harness.

sol-pi-hermes.name: SoL-Pi for Hermes
sol-pi-hermes.summary: Standalone Hermes plugin port of the SoL-Pi mechanism family.

verified-oss-loop.name: Verified OSS Loop
verified-oss-loop.summary: Project-neutral protocol for roadmap-driven, evidence-backed human and agent contribution. Governance/reference infrastructure, not runtime.

hermes-agent-cluster.name: Hermes Agent Cluster
hermes-agent-cluster.summary: Application-layer cluster of Hermes agent workers with its own capability scheduler, leases, heartbeat state machine (online -> degraded -> offline) and orphan rescheduling. Recorded because it performs RESOURCE PLACEMENT, which the architecture assigns to Kerdoios: it is a competing placement authority, not a peer runtime substrate. Two schedulers over one fleet is exactly the duplication this registry exists to surface. The repository is live, so `architecture_status` is merged; what is superseded is its claim on placement, recorded in `not_here` and the `legacy_of` edge.

oh-my-pi.name: OMP (Oh My Pi)
oh-my-pi.summary: Coding-agent runtime. Zer0 executes through it, and the RLM context extension lineage lives on its branches. It is one harness among peers, never a mandatory architectural root.
oh-my-pi.note: The earlier registry pinned this fork to d707478 on rfc/interactive-performance-stack, which is the head of OPEN PR #77 — an unmerged fork branch presented as architecture truth.

deepseek-harness.name: DeepSeek Harness
deepseek-harness.summary: Plugin-oriented execution harness: models, tools, sessions, sandboxes and UI are all plugins. Zer0 integrates through its adapter/plugin seams rather than making a Zer0-specific fork its architectural centre.
deepseek-harness.note: Absent from the previous registry entirely, despite being a primary execution surface. Its llm-pi-ai catalog is the authority for provider and model identity — z0 must consume it, not mirror it.

hermes-agent.name: Hermes Agent
hermes-agent.summary: Upstream harness. Several Zer0 systems ship as Hermes plugins (Kerdoios today; hermes-jev-skills, hermes-keel), which is an implementation detail of those components, not of the harness abstraction.

sol-pi.name: SoL-Pi
sol-pi.summary: Upstream research origin of the SoL-Pi mechanism family. There is NO canonical `sol-pi` component in the network: the mechanisms are Action Fusion, observation packing/reduction, verified reduction and context economics, implemented in sol-pi-omp and sol-pi-hermes.

o8.name: o8
o8.summary: Multi-harness control room and AODL catalog member.

firstmate.name: Firstmate
firstmate.summary: An agent distro. Explicitly NOT itself a harness — classifying it as one is the category error this file exists to prevent.

agenttrace.name: AgentTrace
agenttrace.summary: Local-first TUI/CLI over agent-session history. An observational consumer, NOT the neutral metric authority — Tokenomics owns measurement semantics.

NanoJev.name: NanoJev
NanoJev.summary: JEV-family implementation. A candidate behind z0intelligence's DecisionBackend contract, not an owner of decision policy.

laya.name: Laya
laya.summary: Typed-decision model family; a DecisionBackend candidate behind z0intelligence.

laya-coreml.name: Laya (Core ML)
laya-coreml.summary: Apple Core ML / Neural Engine runtime for Laya typed decisions.

laya-mlx.name: Laya (MLX)
laya-mlx.summary: Native MLX runtime for Laya typed decision models.

memento.name: Memento
memento.summary: Fork of the Memento screen recorder; upstream last active 2024. A possible FUTURE prospective sensor for screen/computer-use history — emphatically not the current runtime memory authority. Zer0 has no memory authority today.
memento.note: The previous registry listed this as `kind: memory`, `status: idea`, and a peer component. It is a 2024 screenshot recorder.

huggingface.name: Hugging Face Hub
huggingface.note: z0intelligence may pin a small intentional model set: selection + revision + role + residency ARE Zer0-owned facts. Architecture family and file metadata are not.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.note: Local runtime state is discovered on the machine, never committed.

litellm.name: LiteLLM
litellm.note: Kerdoios consumes this. Kerdoios is explicitly NOT another gateway, and must not grow a parallel cost table.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.note: Discover live. An offline snapshot is admissible only as a provenance-stamped fallback cache, never as the primary fact.

opentelemetry.name: OpenTelemetry
opentelemetry.note: OTel remains the TRANSPORT. Tokenomics owns Zer0-specific semantics and must not reimplement OTel.

groq.name: Groq
groq.note: Reachable and authenticated when a key is present. Provider-side rate limits (requests/day, tokens/day) are discovered, never assumed: they are per-account facts, so they must be read from the API rather than hardcoded.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.note: Same contract as Groq. Note that rate-limit dimensions are not always self-consistent (a `remaining` value has been observed exceeding its own `limit`), so a consumer must not treat a single dimension as authoritative.

nous.name: Nous Portal
nous.note: Catalog reachable; credentials currently require re-login, so availability is `unavailable` until a usable credential exists. A reachable catalog is not an available provider.

vercel.name: Vercel AI Gateway
vercel.note: Account-wide 403 ("requires a valid credit card on file"). A gateway model listed as "zero-cost metadata" is NOT thereby available; a catalog name cannot confer availability.

xai.name: xAI
xai.note: Credential requires re-login; availability is `unavailable`. Any use must be economically justified against the free providers first.

blueprint.name: Blueprint
blueprint.summary: ATLAS / vertical-farming digital-twin product line. Its GitHub description ("Product blueprint monorepo: architecture, brand, specs") is stale and misleading; the open PRs are the soil-to-cell prototype.
blueprint.note: Referent verified during the current-state sweep. A product line, not network architecture — it must not enter the almanac as a component.

solarpunk.name: solarpunk
solarpunk.summary: Actively developed GrowTwin / agritech product repo. Legacy *relative to Zer0 architecture*, which is not the same claim as abandoned.
solarpunk.note: 442 open PRs and commits through 2026-09. Do not describe it as a dead donor repo; do not describe it as Zer0 infrastructure either.

openjev.name: OpenJev (alias)
openjev.summary: `kvnloo/openjev` resolves to `kvnloo/z0intelligence`. The old registry listed it as an independent decision component owning local SLM decision heads; that was a duplicate ownership claim over one repository.
openjev.note: Ownership converged into z0intelligence's DecisionBackend / cognition surface. Retained only as alias provenance so older references resolve.

hermes-k8s-lab.name: hermes-k8s-lab
hermes-k8s-lab.summary: Kubernetes substrate work: cluster templates, CPU service workloads and GPU pools kept scaled to zero. Deliverable 7 (Kubernetes as an OPTIONAL runtime substrate) depends on it, and its offers already reach Kerdoios through the kubernetes provider.
hermes-k8s-lab.note: Declared by `local_path` and NOT by `repo` because it has no remote at all (`git remote -v` is empty), so it has no canonical identity to register against. `components.yaml` requires a `repo`, and inventing one would register a repository that does not exist. This entry exists so the almanac accounts for the tree; promoting it to a component is blocked on a remote, not on a decision.

k8s-maintainer.name: k8s-maintainer
k8s-maintainer.note: Name collision, not a substrate. The name reads as cluster infrastructure; it triages upstream Kubernetes issues. Recorded so the collision stops being rediscovered, and so it is not mistaken for hermes-k8s-lab.

aodl.intent.v1.summary: Typed intent / plan contract. Governs execution; is not runtime execution.

aodl.observed_state.v1.summary: Observed execution state distinct from the compiled plan.

tokenomics.event.v0.summary: Vendor-neutral usage / cost / latency / outcome event envelope.

tokenomics.report.v1.summary: Aggregated reconciliation, coverage and verified-task report.

z0int.decision_receipt.v1.summary: Replayable routing/policy decision receipt (state, candidates, quota, outcome).

z0int.cognition.receipt.v1.summary: Cognition decision receipt including the eligible candidate set and surface verdict.

kerdoios.placement.v1.summary: Placement decision over a resource portfolio. Allocation, not execution.

kerdoios.quota_state.v1.summary: Dimensional quota state (rpm/rpd/tpm/tpd) with per-dimension provenance.

flow.prediction.v1.summary: OS-context prediction with horizon metadata and gates.

rlm.evidence_handle.v0.summary: Addressable handle into the evidence plane, rehydratable on demand.

z0eval.study.v1.summary:
Frozen reproducible study record. Immutable once published.
The id is `z0eval` (abbreviated), not `z0evals`. This entry previously read `z0evals.study.v1`, which named a contract that does not exist: z0evals declares `const: z0eval.study.v1` in schemas/study-manifest.schema.json and every real manifest carries `schema_version: z0eval.study.v1`. The registry is supposed to describe what exists, so it now does. Abbreviation is already the convention elsewhere -- z0intelligence emits `z0int.*` -- so this is alignment rather than a new style.

harness.execution.v0.summary: The harness-neutral execution seam. Every harness adapter implements this and nothing above it may special-case a harness.

omp.session.aggregate.summary: OMP-specific session-level token rollup for Tokenomics reconciliation.

omp.rlm.spill.v0.summary: OMP-specific RLM context-spill surface. Not a shared contract.

cu.stage_intent.v0.summary: OMP-specific Handsfree / computer-use window and layout intent.

dsh.llm_pi_ai.catalog.summary: DSH llm-pi-ai provider/model catalog. The AUTHORITY for provider and model identity — z0 consumes this rather than mirroring it.

hermes.plugin.v0.summary: Hermes plugin surface. Several Zer0 components ship through it.

agenttrace.span.v0.summary: Historical agent span for observability export. Observational only.

kerdoios.resource_offer.v1.summary:
One normalized shape for every execution offer regardless of substrate: host CPU/GPU, Kubernetes, or a remote provider (Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, Nous, Vercel, xAI). Kerdoios owns the type and selects among offers. Producers emit it; consumers must NOT special-case a provider outside the adapter/placement boundary.
Status is uneven and the registry should say so. Produced today: the host runtime and the remote provider adapters. NOT yet produced: Kubernetes. The only k8s lab (hermes-k8s-lab) is unpublished -- it has no git remote and no GitHub repository -- so the k8s producer is a declared gap, not an implemented one. Fields with no producer anywhere: route, economic_class, throughput, residency, startup_cost, location, node, backend, warm, resident, startup_ms, health_endpoint, queue_depth, namespace, pod, service. `resident` must be a live-runtime observation and never config intent.

z0int.decision_result.v1.summary: Frozen DecisionRequest/DecisionResult pair for a DecisionBackend. This is the host-vs-k8s parity contract: the same request must produce the same result whether served by an in-process host backend or by a service, with only transport and placement differing. What may differ: transport latency, queue time, process identity. What may NOT differ: the chosen action, probabilities, model identity and revision. No service implementation exists yet, so parity is declared and unproven; any comparison must use the existing comparability gate rather than a bespoke comparator.

flow_prediction.v1.summary: Superseded spelling of `flow.prediction.v1`. Identical owner and summary; the id was normalised to the owner-prefixed `<owner>.<thing>.v<major>` convention. Retained so older references resolve.

kerdoios.route.v1.summary: Model/provider routing decision with cost estimate.

os.next_context.v0.summary: Shadow prediction of next desktop context episode. Restored with the owner origin/main declared; the audit record notes z0intelligence also carries os-context machinery, so ownership here is worth confirming rather than assuming.

minimal.summary: One supported harness. Pick which; nothing else is implied.

core.summary: A harness plus the contract and measurement spine.

personal.summary: Learned cognition — selection, escalation and activation.

desktop.summary: Predictive OS/context state and interaction surfaces.

compute.summary: Resource discovery, quota accounting and placement.

research.summary: Experiment, evidence, publication and public research.

full.summary: Every owned component with a live or experimental implementation.
